walkthroughs.body_html: The three most important chords are I, IV and V. In C major they are C, F and G. These three power thousands of pop and folk songs.
The 12-bar blues is a pattern of 12 bars using just I, IV and V. It powered early rock and roll — Elvis, Chuck Berry — and countless blues songs.
A cadence is the chord ending of a phrase. V to I (perfect cadence) feels finished. IV to I (plagal) is the 'amen' ending. Cadences are musical punctuation.
